information_wall.policy_input: correct task language plus current policy observation only

adapter.initialization: fresh deterministic functional identity from the frozen source base for each stage

training_recipe.physical_batch: every rank contains equal samples from two tasks; rank/task assignments rotate every update
training_recipe.sampling: fresh deterministic task permutation per complete cycle, then no-replacement episode cycles and no-replacement action-chunk cycles
training_recipe.cross_rank_assignment: eight disjoint tasks per update; every 3-update cycle visits all 24 tasks exactly once
training_recipe.loss_reduction: equal samples per task then ordinary batch mean
training_recipe.exact_resume: sample identity is a pure function of complete cycle, update phase, rank, task, and local task offset

data.sampling: uniform complete task cycles -> uniform episode -> uniform action chunk; exact equal task counts within each selected physical batch

profile_contract.selection: profile B144 first because it preserves the measured full-24 global batch and utilization; use B128 only if B144 OOMs or is unstable
required_checks: each physical batch contains exactly two equally weighted tasks
each global update contains eight disjoint tasks
each consecutive three-update cycle covers all 24 tasks exactly once
loss and gradients are finite for consecutive steps
rank-128 shared LoRA is the only trainable object

development.selection_data: fixed validation action-loss panel is diagnostic; complete 8-task x 50 closed-loop success selects observed-best

formal_run.budget_role: fresh partial-task mixed ceiling search in evidence-gated one-hour segments
formal_run.selection_rule: Fresh-train from identity at the selected profile batch. Preserve the same global action-query batch, optimizer, scheduler, and task/sample clock as the full-24 run while replacing each 24-task averaged update with three rotating 8-task updates. Retain roughly 30-step checkpoints through the first two segments and sparse checkpoints later. Select by paired full validation success and cross-task breadth; exact-resume only while the observed-best moves right without sustained material multi-task decline.

final.selection_data: no test outcomes; retrain once from fresh identity after development selection

formal_run.selection_rule: fresh final-32 retrain only after owner-facing focused AS/RL handoff and development selection

checkpointing.retained_state: shared LoRA, optimizer, scheduler, per-rank RNG, deterministic cyclic-subset sampler cursor, metrics cursor, contract and hashes
